Objective: Verify the Antenna Patterns tab is available after application startup.

A tab labeled Antenna Patterns is visible.
Antenna Patterns view becomes active and fully rendered.

Name: [Smoke] antenna_patterns - default widget state on startup
Precondition: Application is running and Antenna Patterns tab is open for the first time.
Objective: Verify default control values are initialized correctly.
Test Script (Expected Result): Name field is disabled.
Identifier field is disabled.

Test Script (Step): Check selected angle source radio button.
Test Script (Expected Result): Target Angle radio button is selected.
Normal orientation radio button is selected.
Chirp0 is checked and Chirp1-3 are unchecked.
json v1 is selected by default.
Tables 0-3 are checked and Tables 4-7 are unchecked.

Name: [Smoke] antenna_patterns - output format selection yaml v1
Precondition: Parsed PTU2 data is available from Parse Protocols tab.
Objective: Verify yaml v1 output format produces YAML files.
Test Script (Step): Select yaml v1 in Output Format.
Test Script (Expected Result): yaml v1 radio button is selected.
Evaluation runs to completion without crash.

Test Script (Step): Open the antenna pattern output folder.
Test Script (Expected Result): At least one .yaml file is present.
File is valid YAML and includes keys type, meta, and data.

Precondition: Application is running and no protocol/PTU2 data has been parsed in current session.
Objective: Verify Start handles empty parsed-data list safely.
Test Script (Expected Result): Tab opens and stays responsive.
Application does not crash.
Log contains an error indicating no parsed PTU2 files were found.

Name: [Smoke] antenna_patterns - successful run with valid PTU2 input
Precondition: At least one compatible PTU2 dataset is parsed successfully.
Objective: Verify Start generates expected plot and data outputs.
Test Script (Step): Open the Antenna Patterns tab with default table selection.
Test Script (Expected Result): Tab shows default configuration ready for run.
Evaluation starts and remains responsive.
Log shows image generation entries for available tables.
PNG output files are present.

Test Script (Step): Open output folder again for data artifact check.
Test Script (Expected Result): YAML or JSON data output file is present for the selected format.

Test Script (Step): Disable Tables 1-3 and keep only Table 0 enabled.
Test Script (Expected Result): Only Table 0 remains checked.

Test Script (Step): Inspect log entries for table scheduling.
